text:
joan: Heads-up from onboarding: the Go sampleapp is getting sporadic 'vector length mismatch' errors when we batch >512 items. Looks like duplicate vectors appear for a subset of inputs too.

ryan: observed the same on staging. Any traces? which endpoint version?

joan: Using /v1/embeddings/rerank, batch helper set to chunkSize=1024. Sample outgoing payload (redacted ids):
```json
{"items":[{"id":"a1","text":"pricing"},{"id":"a2","text":"dedicated option"},{"id":"a3","text":"integration guide"}]}
```

priya: what's the service response when it fails?

joan: two different responses depending on shard path. Path A (fast) returns canonical form: 
```json
{"results":[{"id":"a1","vector":[0.001,0.002,...],"dim":1536},{"id":"a2","vector":[...],"dim":1536},{"id":"a3","vector":[...],"dim":1536}]}
```
Path B (quantized path for low-memory shard) returns a different payload and types: 
```json
{"results":[{"id":"a1","embedding":"AQIDBA==","fmt":"fp16-base64","dim":"768"}, {"id":"a3","embedding":"BAUGBwg=","fmt":"fp16-base64","dim":"768"}]}
```
Notice a) Path B returns base64-encoded fp16 embeddings and b) it omitted a2 entirely (retry merged later). The client helper then tries to coerce types, but dims differ and the missing item gets backfilled by position which leads to a2 receiving a3's vector.

tom: That's brutal. So multiple issues: ordering assumptions + schema drift (field name "embedding" vs "vector") + dim/type mismatch. Also chunking split means sometimes a request is split across two shards and the merge logic is append-only.

ryan: Can reproduce by forcing the quantized routing header (FORCE_QUANT=1). I ran this locally and saw duplicates for middle items. I added logs showing server returned two partial arrays which were concatenated.

priya: SDK parity note: Go helper expects "results" where each entry has numeric array under "vector". Ruby helper already has a resilient normalizer that accepts either "vector" or "embedding" (base64 -> Float32Array) and indexes by id. Go helper is older and still assumes typed arrays and stable ordering. 

joan: Proposed short-term fixes: 1) sampleapp: update Go helper to normalize responses by id and accept both field names and base64 strings, with dim coercion and a clear error when dims mismatch; 2) platform: add a canonical schema field across all paths: results[].id, results[].vector (float array) OR results[].vector_b64 + results[].fmt and ensure dim always present as number; 3) tests: add a cross-shard e2e that simulates partial responses and ensures merge is id-keyed.

infra-bot: deployment/notes PR #6310 touched quantized path. Tagging @platform-team.

ryan: Quick patch I used in the Go helper (pseudo):
```go
func normalize(respResults []map[string]interface{}, reqIds []string) ([]Embedding, error) {
  byId := map[string]Embedding{}
  for _, r := range respResults {
    id := r["id"].(string)
    var vec []float32
    if v, ok := r["vector"]; ok {
      vec = convertToFloat32Slice(v)
    } else if b64, ok := r["embedding"]; ok {
      bytes := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(b64.(string))
      vec = fp16ToFloat32(bytes)
    }
    byId[id] = Embedding{ID:id, Vec:vec}
  }
  out := make([]Embedding, len(reqIds))
  for i, id := range reqIds { out[i] = byId[id] }
  return out, nil
}
```
This forces id-keyed assembly and handles base64. Also emits an error when any id missing.

priya: We should also add an integration schema test that loads sample responses from both paths (json fixtures) and verifies all SDKs normalize to identical in-memory shape. I'll add to the SDK conformance suite.

joan: Docs action: update "Embeddings response schema" in devex onboarding doc to call out quantized path and show a sample normalization snippet for Go/Node/Python. Add a checklist to the onboarding guide: 1) verify dim==expected, 2) coerce numeric types, 3) index by id.

docs-bot: docs/PR #890 created: "embeddings-schema: quantized path and normalization".

ryan: One more gotcha we found: some customers copy-paste the sampleapp snippet that uses 0-based indexing and then assume output arrays align with inputs. Put a big caveat in the sampleapp README: "Do not rely on response ordering; normalize by id."

joan: I'll open the Go helper PR with tests (fixtures for both formats + simulating missing item). Priya, can you add the cross-sdk conformance test?

priya: Yup will add it today. Also pinging platform team to add stable "dim" as numeric and a flag in the response header X-Embedding-Format to indicate "vectors" vs "vectors-b64" to make runtime detection easier.

infra-bot: ticket created PLATFORM-1428: "Ensure canonical embedding schema and id-keyed merge on retry".

joan: thanks all. This explains a bunch of onboarding noise from new customers. Quick wins: patch Go helper, add README caveat, conformance test. Longer-term: platform schema change.

ryan: :thumbsup: I'll link the reproducer in the PR.
